description: This file defines a page object model class for the login page of the OrangeHRM web application, providing methods to open the login page and wait for readiness.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Represents the login page in the Selenium page object model, providing an interface to open the page and wait for its key element.

methods.name: LoginPage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the page object with a WebDriver instance.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Navigates the browser to the specified base URL and waits until the login form element is present.
